messages:
Maya Patel: Morning — first day and running into k8s access trouble. I can see contexts with `kubectl config get-contexts` but when I `kubectl get ns` it errors with 'forbidden' (rbac). My current context is `redwood-dev/maya`. Can someone point me to the correct namespace and who to ping for RBAC? Thanks! :wave:

Sam (infra): @Maya Patel welcome! You need a namespace-binding created. Which namespace do you need — onboarding or dev? If it's for the onboarding exercise we usually create `onboarding-<name>`. We can give you `view` or `edit` temporarily.

Maya Patel: Ideally onboarding namespace so I can port-forward a local service. Name can be `onboarding-maya`. Also what's the kubeconfig entry name? I have `redwood-dev/maya`.

Sam (infra): Ok I created a serviceaccount `sa/maya-onboard` in ns `onboarding-maya` and applied a RoleBinding to the `edit` clusterrole (temporary, 24h). Try these: 

```
# switch to cluster context
kubectl config use-context redwood-dev/maya
# verify namespace is available
kubectl get ns onboarding-maya
kubectl auth can-i get pods -n onboarding-maya
```

You should be able to `kubectl get pods -n onboarding-maya` now. LMK if `kubectl auth can-i` still returns no.

Maya Patel: Trying now... `kubectl get pods -n onboarding-maya` shows pods, yay. Quick q: how do I port-forward svc/web to local 8080?

Leah (eng): Use `kubectl port-forward svc/web 8080:80 -n onboarding-maya`. If the service targetPort is 8080 then do `kubectl port-forward svc/web 8080:8080 -n onboarding-maya`.

Ash - DevEx: Also you can set the namespace on your current context so you don't need `-n` each time: 

```
kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=onboarding-maya
```

Then `kubectl get pods` will default to that namespace.

Ryan (oncall): Heads up — infra only granted `edit` for 24h. If you need the binding extended, ping @sam (infra) or create a ticket. Cluster-scoped permissions still require a formal request.

onboard-bot: Welcome Maya Patel! We've attached the onboarding checklist to your profile and created the namespace `onboarding-maya`. If you hit access issues, file a ticket at https://redwood/intra/support with label `kube-onboard`.

Maya Patel: Thanks all, that fixed it. One small followup — my kubectl completion isn't working on mac zsh, any quick tip?

Ash - DevEx: `brew install kubectl` then add completion: `kubectl completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_kubectl` and source per the docs. I'll DM a quick doc link and add a note to the onboarding doc.

Maya Patel: perfect, appreciate it :tada:
